title: Uwakone-hozo-uchi-nuki-komisen
jp: 上小根ホゾ打ち抜き込み栓打ち
guidance: The upper small root passes through the post and carries the 腰; a square 込み栓 is driven horizontally through the post's cheeks and the big root and cut off flush with both faces, so the joint cannot be pulled apart.

source.title: Uwakone-hozo-uchi-nuki-komisen
source.author: Japanese joinery project
source.modifications: authored from the reference sheet in closed pose, exploded for the assemble animation, sunset lighting baked; the baking rig's ground slab is omitted
source.credit: Original geometry authored for this collection from the reference sheet 柱（軸組）の納まり; CC BY 4.0.

usage: Upper-tier through tenon where the member above the post needs the fuller bearing shoulder and the pin passes through both cheeks.
strengths: Square komisen through post and big root is easy to inspect.
The 腰 sits low so the upper shoulder carries bearing.
weaknesses: The through mortise and pin hole weaken the post.
Cut flush on both faces, so re-pinning needs re-cutting.
